cardStyleDesc: The theme’s look: how cards, controls and pages are drawn.

experimentsIntro: Early-access features still in development. Turn one on to enable it for your account. You can switch it off at any time.
experimentsEmpty: No experiments are available right now.

chat.description: What you see while the agent works.

autonomy.description: When the agent may start a turn without a message from you.

long_threads.title: Long threads
long_threads.description: How the agent keeps its place as a thread grows long.

layout.title: Layout

voiceInputDesc: Enable microphone icon in the chat bar for speech-to-text.
turnEndScrollDesc: Where the chat view lands once the assistant finishes replying.
shareLinkOpen: Open app and file links in
shareLinkOpenDesc: Links in a reply to an app or file the agent made.
turnEndScrollReplyStart: Show the start of the reply
turnDisplayDesc: Show the model’s reasoning as it streams.
streamingModeDesc: Show text as it arrives, or reveal one paragraph at a time.
composerTrayDesc: Where the plan, tasks and wakeups show while the agent works: as chips above the composer, or in a strip inside it.
toolCallLayoutDesc: Show one line that names the current step, or each step as a row.

tradingPermission.title: Trading permission
tradingPermission.desc: How the agent handles orders at your connected brokerages. Paper orders are not affected. What you tell the agent in a conversation can narrow this, but only this setting lets orders skip your approval.
tradingPermission.noTradingDesc: The agent doesn't start trades. If you ask it for a specific order, it still waits for your approval.
tradingPermission.approveEachDesc: Every live order and staged instruction waits for your approval before it is sent.
tradingPermission.planFirstDesc: The agent agrees a plan with you, then can place orders inside it without waiting for your approval on each one. Useful when it works while you're away.
tradingPermission.autonomousDesc: The agent trades on its own judgment toward what you've asked of it. It may place orders you aren't aware of or haven't approved.

agreement.title: Let orders go out without your approval?
agreement.planFirst: Live orders and staged instructions at your connected brokerages will no longer wait for your approval. The agent is told to agree a plan with you before trading, but nothing enforces that.
agreement.autonomous: The agent can trade on its own judgment toward what you have asked of it, until you tell it otherwise. It may place orders you are not aware of or have not approved.
agreement.common: Orders are real and can lose money. The agent can misread data, misunderstand an instruction, or act on information that is out of date. You are responsible for every order placed through your accounts, including ones you did not see before they were sent. You can go back to approving each order at any time in Settings, and every order is recorded on the <orders>Orders page</orders>.
agreement.checkbox: I understand that orders the agent places are my responsibility.
agreement.changed: This agreement has changed since the page loaded. Reload to read the current version.

preferencesDesc: You can also ask the agent to change these in any chat.
subagentsDefaultDesc: Let the agent hand work to subagents. Threads follow this unless you switch one the other way in its chat input.
ownContext: Use my preferences and memory in shared workspaces
ownContextDesc: On your own messages in a shared workspace, the agent follows your answer preferences and can read your memory. In a conversation shared with the workspace, its answers are visible to the workspace's members.
resetConfirmMsg: This will clear your risk tolerance, investment style, agent settings and dashboard layout. Your models, model settings and API keys stay as they are. You can set everything up again anytime in Settings or via the agent. Are you sure?
completeProfileDesc: A few questions so the agent's research fits how you invest.

defaultModelChange.title: Make {{model}} your default model?
defaultModelChange.newThreads: Use it for new threads only
defaultModelChange.newThreads_pair: Use them for new threads only
defaultModelChange.existingThreads: Also switch threads on your current default ({{previous}})
defaultModelChange.existingThreads_pair: Also switch threads on your current defaults ({{previous}})
defaultModelChange.appliedNew: Default set to {{model}} for new threads.
defaultModelChange.appliedNew_pair: Defaults set to {{model}} for new threads.
defaultModelChange.appliedExistingNone: Default set to {{model}}. No threads were using {{previous}}.
defaultModelChange.appliedExistingNone_pair: Defaults set to {{model}}. No threads were using {{previous}}.
defaultModelChange.scopeLabel: When you change your default model
defaultModelChange.scopeDesc: Threads on any other model always keep theirs.
defaultModelChange.scopeExistingThreads: Also switch threads using the old default

starredModelsDesc: First in the model picker. Star a model there, or add one here.
searchProviderDesc: Search engine the agent uses for web searches.
searchProviderUpgradeHint: Some search providers are available on higher plans.
searchDepthDesc: How thoroughly the agent searches the web. Deeper levels use more credits per search.
searchDepthUpgradeHint: Deeper search levels are available on higher plans.
compactionProfileDesc: When a conversation compacts. Leave on system default and each model gets its own: 500k for Claude and GPT, and what the context window affords for the rest.
nativeCompactionAnthropicDesc: Claude summarizes the conversation itself when it compacts, so it keeps its reasoning in the turns it keeps. Its summary is readable, and a model you switch to reads the same one.
nativeCompactionOpenAIDesc: OpenAI compacts the conversation into an encrypted summary that only OpenAI models can read, through the API or a ChatGPT login. The compaction card shows a plain record of the conversation instead. Switch the thread to another provider's model and it gets that record, not the summary, so it loses detail from earlier tool results.

aggressive.label: Aggressive
aggressive.description: Compact early. Safe for any model; summaries may feel more frequent.

extended.label: Extended
extended.description: Preserve more context. Good default for 400k-context models.

economy.label: Economy
economy.description: Stays under 272k, past which OpenAI bills a whole request at long-context rates.

relaxed.label: Relaxed
relaxed.description: More room before a summary on 1M-context models.

expansive.label: Expansive
expansive.description: Half of a 1M window before a summary. Each call costs more as the thread grows.

maximal.label: Maximum
maximal.description: Most of a 1M window. Highest cost per call; for 1M-context models only.

modelTuning.perModelDesc: Settings that apply only to one model. Anything left on Default follows the account defaults above.
modelTuning.effortDesc: How hard a model thinks before answering, where the model offers a choice.
modelTuning.guidanceDesc: How much instruction the agent carries into a turn. Concise trims the coaching and leaves the facts.
modelTuning.coldCompaction: Summarize long threads after a break
modelTuning.coldCompactionDesc: When you come back to a long conversation after a while, it is summarized before your next message, which costs less than processing all of it again.
modelTuning.compactionModelDesc: Used for compacting long conversation context.
modelTuning.subagentsLink: Each subagent's model and effort are set in <pane>Plugins → Subagents</pane>.
modelTuning.showAdvancedDesc: Account defaults, per-model tuning and routing.

payerOrder.rule: Tags show who pays. <ownKey /> comes before <deployment />.
payerOrder.skipped: Runs only on turns paid with credits
payerOrder.skippedSelfHosted: Runs only on turns on the server's key
payerOrder.skippedNote: Faded ones skip turns you pay for yourself.
payerOrder.savedNote: Saved fallbacks run on every turn, including ones you pay for yourself.

autoApproveHandoffsDesc: Tasks go to a workspace's Analyst without an approval card. Each hand-off still shows as a card you can follow or stop.
autoApproveWorkspaceCreationDesc: A workspace for new work is created without an approval card.

server.locationDesc: A change applies to new computers. Computers you already have stay where they are.
server.marketDataDesc: Yahoo Finance needs no key. A key adds more data.
server.webSearchDesc: The agent searches with the provider you pick here.
server.keysReach: A saved key applies on this server right away, while Docker and cloud computers you already have keep the keys they were created with, and a computer on this machine picks up a change at its next start.

definition.experiments: Early features you can try before they ship.

logoutDesc: You'll need to sign in again to use LangAlpha.
resetPreferencesDesc: Clears your investing answers and agent settings. Your models and API keys stay as they are.
localeDesc: The language LangAlpha is shown in.
timezoneDesc: Dates and times are shown in this timezone.
themeDesc: Light or dark. Auto follows your system setting.
fontSizeDesc: Scales the text across the app on this device.

artifacts.destinationDesc: Each comment's default. Pick another thread in the comment box for any one comment, or bind a file to a thread to send all its comments there.
artifacts.enterDesc: What Enter does in the comment box. The other is always one click away, or ⌘/Ctrl+Enter.
artifacts.answersDesc: Every comment gets an answer under it. This is where the full answer goes unless you say otherwise when you send.

approvalsDesc: Actions the agent may take without an approval card.
defaultModelsDesc: The models new conversations and background work run on.
outputFormatDesc: Drag to set the order you prefer. Quick questions are always answered in the chat; for bigger work the agent uses your highest choice that fits.
outputFormatDecides: The agent decides for now. Reorder to set your preference.

visual.title: Visual
visual.desc: Charts and dashboards in the chat for a quick look, or a styled HTML report for long research and anything you want to keep or share. Takes longer and uses more credits.

markdown.title: Summary + Markdown file
markdown.desc: The full findings in a Markdown file, with what you need to know now in the reply.

text.title: Chat
text.desc: Everything in the reply, as soon as the research is done. Fastest, with no files.

researchDepthDesc: How much research a question gets by default.
reachingOutDesc: When the agent gets in touch without being asked.
instructionsDesc: Notes you asked the agent to keep. It follows them in every answer.

planUsage.planDesc: What your plan includes and what it costs.
planUsage.usageDesc: Credits used today and this month, by day and by thread.

integrations.chatAppsDesc: Message your agent from Slack, Discord, Telegram or Feishu, and have automations send their results there.
integrations.connectedAppsDesc: Apps you've signed in to with your LangAlpha account.

desktop.notificationsGroupDesc: Shown by your computer when you are not looking at the thread.
desktop.notifyTurnDesc: When a reply you asked for is ready.
desktop.notifyNeedsInputDesc: When the agent stops to ask you something.
desktop.notifyWakeupDesc: When the agent checks back in on its own, or a price alert fires.
desktop.notifyAutomationDesc: When an automation finishes a run.
desktop.notifyStarted: Show when a background run starts
desktop.notifyStartedDesc: A silent notice as a price alert or automation begins, replaced by its result. A wakeup tells you only when it found something.
desktop.badgeDesc: For threads with a new reply or waiting on you.
desktop.menubarIcon: Show icon in the menu bar
desktop.menubarIconDesc: Markets, your portfolio and the agent's activity, a click away.
desktop.menubarItemsDesc: Shown next to the icon. Drag to reorder.
desktop.menubarItemsDescTooltip: Shown in the tray icon's tooltip. Drag to reorder.
desktop.menubarItemsDescMenu: Shown at the top of the tray menu. Drag to reorder.
desktop.menubarLogoDesc: Off leaves only your items. With none to show, the logo stays so there is something to click.
desktop.menubarExtendedDesc: Show the pre-market or after-hours move when there is one.
desktop.panelGroupDesc: What opens when you click the icon.
desktop.panelSectionsDesc: Shown in this order. Drag to reorder.
desktop.panelTilesDesc: Up to 4: any index, ETF, crypto or stock.
desktop.panelWatchlistDesc: Which list, and how many rows.
desktop.shortcutDesc: Opens the menu bar panel from any app. Click, then press the keys.
desktop.openAtLoginDesc: Start LangAlpha in the background when you sign in to this computer.
desktop.openAtLoginWindowDesc: Open LangAlpha when you sign in to this computer. With the icon on, it starts in the background instead.
desktop.keepRunning: Keep running in the tray when closed
desktop.keepRunningDesc: Closing the window leaves notifications and the tray icon running.
desktop.automaticUpdatesDesc: New versions download in the background and install the next time you quit. Off, the sidebar offers each one and waits for you to download it.
desktop.unavailable: The desktop app did not answer. Restart it and try again.
